successor_discipline: V1 is left byte-for-byte as committed at 070ae15d. All corrections live here, in a successor record, so the original claim and its correction are both auditable. This follows the V58/V59 manifest precedent.

governance.note: Provenance, cell-level QC and interaction-file structure only. No gene, Ensembl ID, target, program gene or Stage75F edge was read or joined. No HiChIP interaction file was downloaded beyond a 300 KB byte-range prefix used to read the column header.

CORRECTION_1__DONOR_COUNT_WAS_WRONG.authority: Supplementary Data Set 2, sheet 'scATAC-seq QC Metadata', column Donor_ID, whose own dictionary entry reads: 'Donor_ID - A numeric identifier unique to each individual donor.' Its values are two-part tokens such as 06_0615.
CORRECTION_1__DONOR_COUNT_WAS_WRONG.cause: Sample labels have the form REGION_A_B (CAUD_06_0615). I split on underscore and took field A as the donor. The donor key is A_B. Under the wrong key, 06_0615 and 06_1516 collapse to one donor and 09_1589 and 09_35 collapse to one donor.
CORRECTION_1__DONOR_COUNT_WAS_WRONG.class: This is the third identity-parsing error in this workstream (barcodes header off-by-one; Data Set 2 Total column; now the donor key). All three came from inferring a column's meaning instead of reading the dictionary the file ships with. Data Set 2 documents every column in rows 7-19 and I read those rows only after the count was already wrong.

CLUSTER24_CONFIRMED_INDEPENDENTLY.confirmed_by: two independent routes that agree exactly - the 'scATAC Cluster Residence' matrix (sum over 10 sample columns) and a per-cell count over the 'scATAC-seq QC Metadata' sheet filtered to Cluster == Cluster24
CLUSTER24_CONFIRMED_INDEPENDENTLY.note: The microglial cell count is unchanged by the donor-key correction; only its distribution changes. Under the wrong key donor 09 appeared to hold 1,275 microglia; correctly it is 09_1589 with 1,050 and 09_35 with 225.

CORRECTION_2__BENCHMARK_QC_PARAMETERISED.those_are: atlas-wide medians over all 70,631 cells, taken from the GEO barcodes file
CORRECTION_2__BENCHMARK_QC_PARAMETERISED.atlas_values_reproduce: YES - Data Set 2 and the GEO barcodes file agree to 3 decimal places, so the original measurement was correct for the stratum it measured
CORRECTION_2__BENCHMARK_QC_PARAMETERISED.why_it_matters: The work order required measured nuisance parameterised from real Corces FRIP/TSS/fragments, and the object under test is a MICROGLIAL regulatory object. Microglia are a lower-depth population than the atlas average - 23% fewer fragments and 14% lower FRiP - so the benchmark has been simulating a cleaner measurement process than the one the real object would be read through. The direction of the error is optimistic.
CORRECTION_2__BENCHMARK_QC_PARAMETERISED.status: NOT YET APPLIED to the benchmark. Recorded here; applying it is a separate change that must be made before any benchmark result is cited.

FINDING_3__THE_GENOME_WIDE_LOOPS_ARE_PUB.reverses: the V1 statement that instantiating E beyond Data Set 9 was UNCHECKED. It is now checked, and the answer is that the unfiltered loops are fully public.
FINDING_3__THE_GENOME_WIDE_LOOPS_ARE_PUB.where: GEO GSE147672, as per-sample GSM supplementary files, NOT in the series-level supplementary directory
FINDING_3__THE_GENOME_WIDE_LOOPS_ARE_PUB.retrievability_proven: YES - an HTTP byte-range request for the first 300,000 bytes of GSM4441840 returned valid gzip that decompressed to 5,404 complete rows. No DUA, no authentication, no proof-of-work gate.
FINDING_3__THE_GENOME_WIDE_LOOPS_ARE_PUB.THE_DECISIVE_PROPERTY: There is NO SNP column and NO GWAS flag. This is the unfiltered FitHiChIP output, and it carries its own Q-Value_Bias, so a significance threshold can be frozen BY US and applied transparently, instead of inheriting the paper's AD/PD GWAS selection.
FINDING_3__THE_GENOME_WIDE_LOOPS_ARE_PUB.bin_size_note: These per-sample files use 10 kb bins. Supplementary Data Set 9 used 5,001 bp anchors. The two are therefore NOT the same resolution, and Data Set 9 is not simply a row-subset of these files - it is a different binning as well as a different selection.
FINDING_3__THE_GENOME_WIDE_LOOPS_ARE_PUB.how_it_was_found: The series-level supplementary directory contains no loop file at all - it is entirely scATAC. The 68 KB filelist.txt, which enumerates the per-GSM products, is what exposed them. Reading the series directory alone would have produced a confident false negative.

FINDING_4__CONTACT_AND_ACCESSIBILITY_LAY.IDENTITY_LADDER_CAVEAT: The scATAC key is PROVEN - Data Set 2 defines Donor_ID explicitly. The HiChIP key is INFERRED from filename structure, which uses the same REGION-A-B pattern, and is NOT proven. It should be confirmed against a HiChIP sample metadata table before any donor-overlap claim is made load-bearing. Classify as LIKELY_SAME_KEY__UNPROVEN.
FINDING_4__CONTACT_AND_ACCESSIBILITY_LAY.explicit_non_conflation: scATAC donor 04_38 and HiChIP donor 00_38 share the suffix 38 and are NOT the same donor under the A_B key. Recorded because suffix-matching is exactly the shortcut that produced the donor-count error above.
FINDING_4__CONTACT_AND_ACCESSIBILITY_LAY.consequence_for_the_object: E intersects a contact graph measured in 8 donors with an accessibility mask measured in 8 donors, overlapping in only 3. The object is therefore a cross-donor intersection, not a donor-matched one. That is not a defect - it is arguably a strength, since the contact evidence is not merely re-reading the same donors' chromatin - but it must be stated, and it means the object has no within-donor contact-x-accessibility support.
